description: This file defines an abstract class 'CustomShippingQuoteItem' that represents a shipping quote item with price details, including text and BigDecimal price. It provides getters and setters for these fields.

classes.name: CustomShippingQuoteItem
classes.description: An abstract class modeling a shipping quote item with price details.

methods.name: setPriceText
methods.description: Sets the textual description of the price.

methods.name: getPriceText
methods.description: Returns the textual description of the price.

methods.name: setPrice
methods.description: Sets the price of the shipping quote item.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Returns the price of the shipping quote item.
